title: The Sharp Scholars of Pumbedita
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: In [Sanhedrin 17b](https://www.sefaria.org/Sanhedrin.17b.5) they said that Ayfa and Avimi, sons of Rechava, are the sharp scholars of Pumbedita; and they are mentioned in Kiddushin 39b ([compare Kiddushin 39a](https://www.sefaria.org/Kiddushin.39a.2)) and [Menachot 17a](https://www.sefaria.org/Menachot.17a.1) under the anonymous designation "the sharp scholars of Pumbedita," and [Rashi on Kiddushin](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Kiddushin.39a.2.2) and [Rashi on Menachot](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashi_on_Menachot.17a.1.1) explain [that this means] Ayfa and Avimi, sons of Rechava.[^1]

notes.text: Rashi on Menachot directs readers to the identification in Sanhedrin. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1562&lang=en) gives Kiddushin 39a for the Kiddushin reference, while Hyman gives 39b.
